Messages.Author: direwolf
Messages.Body:
Dancing Blades

Requires an anarch.
and/or  and/or  Strike with a melee weapon. If this minion does not have a melee weapon put this card in play as a melee weapon that deals strength damage until the end of combat. If using  , grapples do not restrict this minion's melee strikes this round and cannot be dodged. If using  this minion's melee strikes are ranged this round. If using  this vampire gains an additional strike with the melee weapon.

(Whether dancing in the hand, or magically animated, this gives an edge to a gifted anarch. Pun intended.)

Aikido

Requires an anarch.
and/or  and/or  Strike: dodge. If using  with an optional press. If using  with an optional maneuver. If using  with an additional strike: dodge.

(Aikido is a martial art that is defensive and uses complicated movements in an unpredictable yet effective manner.)
